summary: Frontend-only validation of Phase 1 'Task Reference Attachments' feature on /my-work. All 7 flows executed successfully end-to-end: new-task dialog with evidence checkbox + multi-file reference input, reference-block vs proof-block separation on TaskCard, evidence gate disabling Complete, proof upload flipping the gate green + enabling Complete, task completion moving to Completed tab, View Details dialog showing separate detail-reference (with AI insight summary + action points) and Proof of Work sections, plus regression that normal task w/o evidence/ref completes directly and Photo button still uploads under Proof of work (not reference).

issues: Non-image proof files (e.g. .txt uploaded via Photo hidden input as kind=photo) render inside the proof block as a broken image thumbnail with just a small icon; a filename fallback (as done for reference att-file) would look cleaner. Not a blocker.
Assigned Employee <select> lacks a stable data-testid; only findable by option text. Consider adding data-testid='task-assignee-select' for reliable automation.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: render non-image proof attachments as a filename link (mirror the att-file style used in reference-block) rather than a broken .
OPTIONAL: add data-testid to NewTaskDialog Assigned Employee and Priority selects for stable e2e tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _analyze_reference_file correctly skips non-image/PDF files (Phase 1 by design); confirmed AI insight generated within ~8s for a real PNG reference (both reference-insight-<id> on card and detail-ref-insight-<id>-0 with summary + 3 action points in the detail dialog).

MyWork TaskCard evidence gate correctly uses `t.evidence_required && !hasEvidence` — forced click on the disabled button is silently blocked by the DOM (verified: task remained in active list, no completion).

Complete flow uses window.confirm() — Playwright test must accept dialog; production behavior fine. No toast 'Task completed' appears because the confirm-dismissed flow returned early; when accepted the task moved to Completed with 100% status.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 REF_TEST tasks during testing (evidence gate, evidence no proof, normal, photo proof regression). 3 were deleted via View Details → Delete task → Yes, delete. 'REF_TEST evidence no proof' may still be present in owner's active list; can be removed manually via View Details.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 UI is fully working. Detail dialog Delete button has a two-step confirm (button label changes to 'Yes, delete'); use that selector. Assigned Employee select in NewTaskDialog has no data-testid — use `page.locator('select').filter(has_text='Pick a person').first`. window.confirm is used before Complete — attach `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())`. AI insight only fires for images/PDFs (Phase 1); .txt references will not produce reference-insight-<id> and that is by design, not a bug.
